selection_approach_display: Sheffield checks academic eligibility and the UCAT minimum before ranking most eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total within separate Home and International pools.

course.name: MBChB Medicine
course.notes: Five-year standard-entry Medicine. A101 Graduate Entry Medicine is a separate course and is not executable through this profile.

medical_school.name: School of Medicine and Population Health
medical_school.notes: Production rules are mapped from the supplied Sheffield A100 research pack and its official first-party sources.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible Home applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive total after the academic and UCAT minimum gates.
Eligible International applicants are ranked separately by UCAT cognitive total.
Verified Access to Sheffield (Medicine) applicants must meet the UCAT minimum but progress to the next stage without competitive UCAT ranking.
A100 graduate applicants require a 2:1 degree plus the published BBB school-qualification branch; the combined branch remains a manual-review boundary.

overall_policy.description: Sheffield first checks academic eligibility, then applies the UCAT minimum. Applicants who pass normally proceed to UCAT ranking within the relevant fee-status pool.
not_eligible_if: The applicable academic minimum requirements are not met.
The current-cycle UCAT cognitive total is below 1800 out of 2700.
A required science A-level practical endorsement is not passed.

science_requirement.notes: Environmental Science is also accepted by Sheffield but has no canonical subject identifier in Engine v1.0 and therefore remains a review path.

gcse.sitting_policy: Resits are accepted under the published one-resit, single-resit-sitting conditions; resit timing is a manual-review boundary.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are checked only. Sheffield gives no ranking advantage for exceeding the minimum.

standard_offer.notes: Chemistry or Biology plus a second accepted science.

contextual_offer.notes: Requires grade A in Chemistry or Biology.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Any third A-level is accepted except General Studies or Critical Thinking.
a_level.sitting_policy: Three A-levels must normally be studied within two years and taken in the same first sitting.
a_level.notes: The ordinary AAA, verified contextual AAB and EPQ alternative AAB routes are executable for complete school-leaver profiles. Sheffield's ordinary two-year same-first-sitting condition remains outside the automatic route check.

grade_requirements.notes: Three Higher Level subjects at grade 6, including Chemistry or Biology and a second accepted science.

contextual_offer.requirements: 6 in HL Chemistry or Biology, 6 and 5 in two further HL subjects, and no less than 4 at SL.

ib.notes: The standard 36-point route is executable. Contextual IB and SL minimums remain review paths.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: AA in Chemistry or Biology and a second science.

scottish.contextual_offer: AABBB Highers plus AB Advanced Higher
scottish.notes: Scottish qualifications are an alternative qualification route, not a separate Sheffield applicant pool.

degree.school_qualification_requirement: BBB at A-level, including Chemistry or Biology and a second accepted science.
degree.notes: Applies only to graduates applying to A100. A101 is separate.

post_16.notes: Unsupported qualification equivalences must be verified by Sheffield and are not inferred.

ucat.notes: The 1800 minimum uses the native 2700-point UCAT scale. Most eligible applicants are then ranked by total score.

sjt.notes: SJT is not used for interview shortlisting. Its post-interview use is informational only and cannot affect this profile.

conditions: All resits at a qualification level must be taken in one sitting.
Only one resit per GCSE or A-level is accepted.
Only failing qualifications need to be retaken.
resits.notes: Resit applicants must be reviewed against Sheffield's exact timing and sitting conditions.

exemptions: SQA Higher or Advanced Higher English grade B
english_language.notes: The shared classifier does not represent Sheffield's 7.5 overall IELTS threshold exactly. Automatic International guidance is therefore restricted to applicants with a confirmed published exemption; IELTS and other routes require review.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Applicants under 18 at course start must defer. Professional checks apply after selection and do not affect interview guidance.

ranking_factors.notes: Sole ranking input after academic and minimum-UCAT gates for ordinary applicants.

total_score.calculation_method: Use the UCAT cognitive total directly; no academic composite is calculated.
total_score.notes: GCSEs and post-16 qualifications are threshold-only.

calculation.notes: UCAT is ranked separately for Home and International applicants.

thresholds.notes: Current published minimum on the native 2700 scale.
Historical guidance for the Home pool, not a guaranteed future threshold.
Historical guidance for the International pool, not a guaranteed future threshold.

selection_adjustments.notes: The UCAT minimum still applies. Verified Access to Sheffield (Medicine) applicants progress to the next stage without competitive UCAT ranking after academic requirements are verified.

output_band_policy.notes: The native 2025-26 pool cutpoints are historical guidance. No unsupported converted legacy threshold is executable.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Home and International are separate ranking pools. Scottish and Rest of UK are not separate Sheffield pools.

contextual_eligibility.notes: Sheffield A100 contextual groups must be activated from Step 6 structured contextual evidence via the shared contextual evidence framework. Generic access_to_medicine academic routes and access_to_medicine_profile are not valid evidence for Access to Sheffield (Medicine).

criteria.description: Access Sheffield or Access+ eligibility may activate the published 2027 AAB contextual A-level offer where Step 6 evidence establishes a qualifying criterion.
The specific Access to Sheffield (Medicine) programme must be represented through named Step 6 access/WP programme evidence for the special GCSE branch and UCAT-ranking bypass.
Realising Opportunities evidence requires manual review until cohort and completion timing can be established in structured Step 6 evidence.
Recognised Bradford / Sheffield Hallam pathway evidence requires manual review unless pathway marks, module thresholds and widening-participation criteria are established.

adjustments.policy_description: AAB including grade A in Chemistry or Biology.

conditions: Specific Access to Sheffield (Medicine) programme evidence is verified.
UCAT total is at least 1800 out of 2700.
ranking_bypass_rules.notes: Ordinary UCAT ranking is bypassed after the minimum UCAT gate; no contextual points, guaranteed-interview label, or invented uplift is applied.

contextual_admissions.notes: General Access Sheffield contextual applicants receive the academic adjustment but remain in the ordinary Home UCAT ranking pool.

ranking_pools.name: Home A100
ranking_pools.notes: Includes Home applicants from all UK domiciles; no Scottish or RUK sub-pool is created.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

quotas.name: Home A100 places
quotas.notes: Published place count; not used as a probability.

quotas.name: International A100 places
quotas.notes: Published place count; not used as a probability.

offer_selection.interview_format: Home applicants attend an in-person eight-section MMI; International applicants attend an online panel interview.

interview_scoring.notes: Post-interview MMI and SJT scoring is retained only as source context and is not executable or displayed as a prediction.

standard_offer.notes: Stored as academic eligibility information only.

contextual_offer.notes: Stored as academic eligibility information only. The 2027 AAB Access Sheffield A-level offer is explicitly published on the Sheffield course page.

offer_selection.notes: ApplySmart does not predict offers, interview performance, MMI scores, SJT interview scores, waiting-list outcomes or post-interview ranking.

cycles.notes: Native 2700-scale values used for historical interview guidance.
Raw legacy-scale FOI data retained for context only and never converted for executable comparison.

legacy_scale_policy.notes: Flat multiplication by 0.75 is not treated as exact psychometric equivalence.

historical_admissions.notes: Only the native 2025-26 2700-scale cutpoints are executable historical guidance.

do_not_infer: Do not score GCSEs or post-16 grades after the minimum academic gate.
Do not create Scottish or Rest of UK Sheffield ranking pools.
Do not reject SJT Band 3 or Band 4 during interview shortlisting.
Do not use legacy /3600 values or flat 0.75 conversions as executable thresholds.
Do not treat a historical cutpoint as a guaranteed future interview boundary.
Do not apply contextual points or an invented UCAT uplift.
Do not apply A101 rules to A100.
Do not predict offers, interview performance, waiting-list outcomes or post-interview ranking.
engine_notes.approved_activation_scope: Complete standard A-level school-leaver profiles, Step 6-verified Sheffield contextual A-level school-leaver profiles, standard IB profiles, and International applicants with a supported qualification and a confirmed published English-language exemption. Incomplete Realising Opportunities and Bradford/Hallam pathway evidence remains manual review.
engine_notes.prediction_scope: Medium-confidence interview guidance using the native 2025-26 Home and International UCAT cutpoints after academic and 1800 UCAT gates. Step 6-verified Access to Sheffield (Medicine) applicants use threshold-only interview-likely logic after the minimum UCAT gate because competitive UCAT ranking is bypassed.
engine_notes.blocking_missing_fields_scope: Automatic Engine v1.0 execution boundaries only; these are not missing Sheffield admissions evidence. Genuine evidence gaps are listed in validation.known_unknowns and the research profile evidence_gaps array.
course_specific_notes: Sheffield first checks academic eligibility, then the 1800 UCAT minimum, then ranks most applicants by UCAT within separate Home and International pools.
General Access Sheffield contextual applicants use the Home UCAT ranking pool.
Step 6-verified Access to Sheffield (Medicine) applicants bypass ordinary UCAT ranking after meeting the minimum UCAT and academic requirements.
Access Sheffield / Access+ contextual applicants can receive the published 2027 AAB A-level offer but remain subject to standard GCSE requirements and competitive UCAT ranking.

Realising Opportunities and Bradford/Hallam pathway cases remain manual review when Step 6 evidence cannot establish the required cohort, completion timing, pathway marks or pathway-specific WP criteria.
SJT is not used for interview shortlisting.
